classification.accepted_out_of_branch_event: accepted_fit is true and measurement_status is geometry_inconsistent
classification.branch_model_disagreement: the event has a direct native observation and Gaussian-to-native raw-position distance is less than or equal to the positional tolerance
classification.cross_contract_target_inconsistency: the event has a direct native observation and Gaussian-to-native raw-position distance exceeds the positional tolerance
classification.unresolved: the event lacks a direct native observation

all_frame_conditional_out_of_branch_frac.denominator: all accepted Gaussian fits for the method across all 324 frozen opportunities

branch_consistent_measurement_coverage.denominator: the 221 frozen physics-baseline visible_fit opportunities for each method

denominators.nesting: opportunities are nested within scan, branch and gap event; frames, branches and contracts are not independent experimental replicates

gap_contract.boundary_rule: a maximal contiguous run of false states bounded immediately before and after by true states for the same scan and branch; Gaussian gaps are additionally method-specific

comparison_category.gaussian_only: an overlap-connected interval component contains Gaussian gaps only
comparison_category.shared: an overlap-connected interval component contains at least one gap from each contract
comparison_category.viperleed_only: an overlap-connected interval component contains ViPErLEED gaps only

gap_contract.exact_boundary_agreement: a shared component contains exactly one Gaussian gap and one ViPErLEED gap with identical first and last gap frames
gap_contract.identity: contract plus method when applicable plus scan plus branch plus first gap frame plus last gap frame
gap_contract.matching: within each method, scan and branch, form overlap-connected components of the closed frame intervals from both gap contracts
gap_contract.recovery: record the first direct observation immediately after every bounded contract-specific gap and whether both contracts observe at the first frame after the comparison component

join_contract.gaussian_join: candidate and evaluation records join one-to-one on record_key
join_contract.native_join: series_id equals scan_id, frame equals source_frame, mapped branch equals branch_id, and energy matches

measurability_states.gaussian_contract_measurable: measurement_valid is true; accepted_fit must be identical, while branch consistency is reported separately
measurability_states.viper_native_direct_detectability: significance meets the selected threshold and both raw position deviations are finite; the stored nominal flag must reproduce threshold 2.5
